condition.zh: 住院老年評估 · 吸入性肺炎

tagline.zh: 一口水、一張交班板和一支保溫瓶
tagline.en: A teaspoon of water, a handover board and a thermos

desc.zh: 跟著許主治做住院的周全性老年評估：功能、吞嚥、皮膚、血糖、家屬會談。鼻胃管要不要放，先開口的人是你。
desc.en: Inpatient comprehensive geriatric assessment with Dr Hsu: function, swallowing, skin, sugar, the family meeting. When the feeding tube question comes, you speak first.

desc.zh: 日常生活功能、長照轉介、交班板與夜裡的跌倒預防都在你手上；他回家後的樣子，你最先想到。
desc.en: Activities of daily living, long-term care referral, the handover board and night-time fall prevention are yours; you are the first to picture him back home.

about.zh: 記得每位病人的狗叫什麼名字。今天的茶葉蛋在白袍口袋裡，和一支小手電筒作伴。
about.en: Remembers every patient's dog's name. Today's tea egg is in his coat pocket, keeping a small torch company.

about.zh: 交班板是她的地盤。她說：寫上名字的待辦才會有人做。
about.en: The handover board is her territory. Her rule: a to-do with a name on it gets done.

about.zh: 口袋裡永遠有一支小湯匙。她說：吞嚥是全身最常被忽略的動作。
about.en: Always a teaspoon in her pocket. Her line: swallowing is the body's most overlooked movement.

about.zh: 會把所有藥袋攤在桌上。口頭禪：吃不下的時候，藥也要跟著變。
about.en: Spreads every medicine packet on the table. Motto: when the eating changes, the medicines must change too.

role.zh: 八十八歲，吸入性肺炎第二天
role.en: Eighty-eight, day two of aspiration pneumonia

about.zh: 虛構教學個案。退休木工，輕度失智，糖尿病。這兩天吃得少，上個月在家跌過一次，沒人說。
about.en: Fictional teaching case. Retired carpenter, mild dementia, diabetes. Eating little these two days; fell at home last month and nobody mentioned it.

about.zh: 每天帶一支保溫瓶來，裡面是粥。她覺得他吃不下是她煮得不好。
about.en: Brings a thermos of congee every day. Believes he cannot eat because her cooking is wrong.

about.zh: 在台中上班。訊息很長，每一句都在問：媽媽一個人顧得來嗎？
about.en: Works in Taichung. Long messages, every line asking: can Mum cope alone?

plain.zh: 食物、口水或胃內容物跑進肺裡引起的肺炎。老人家吞嚥變差時最常見，右下肺最常中。
plain.en: Pneumonia from food, saliva or stomach contents going into the lungs. Common when swallowing weakens with age; the right lower lobe is the usual target.

plain.zh: 給東西吃之前的小測驗：清醒、坐直、一小匙水，看會不會嗆咳或聲音變濕。沒過就先不要餵。
plain.en: A quick test before anything by mouth: awake, upright, a teaspoon of water, watching for a cough or a wet voice. If it fails, nothing by mouth yet.

plain.zh: 吃喝時咳嗽、清喉嚨、聲音變濕，表示東西走錯路。沒咳不代表安全，有些人嗆了不咳。
plain.en: Coughing, throat-clearing or a wet voice while eating or drinking: something went down the wrong way. No cough does not mean safe; some people aspirate silently.

plain.zh: 把食物和飲料調成好吞的稠度：軟質、泥狀、增稠的水。比「少吃一點」有用得多。
plain.en: Adjusting food and drink to a swallow-friendly consistency: soft, puréed, thickened fluids. Far more useful than “eat less”.

plain.zh: 從鼻子放進胃的管子，用來灌食。它不能防止吸入性肺炎，常被病人拔掉，放之前要和家人好好談。
plain.en: A tube from the nose into the stomach for feeding. It does not prevent aspiration pneumonia, is often pulled out, and deserves a proper conversation with the family first.

plain.zh: 不只看病，還看功能、認知與心情、吃、藥、家裡與照顧者，一次看完再排計畫。
plain.en: Looking beyond the disease at function, cognition and mood, nutrition, medicines, home and carer, then making one plan.

plain.zh: 吃飯、洗澡、穿衣、上廁所、移位、走路。住院前後各問一次，差距就是住院的代價。
plain.en: Eating, bathing, dressing, toileting, transferring, walking. Ask before and after the admission; the gap is the cost of being in hospital.

plain.zh: 一類刺激胰臟分泌胰島素的降血糖藥。吃得少還照吃，血糖會掉得很低，老人家特別危險。
plain.en: A class of diabetes tablets that make the pancreas release insulin. Taken as usual while eating little, they drive the sugar dangerously low, especially in the elderly.

plain.zh: 血糖太低：冒汗、發抖、發呆、突然很安靜。先坐好或躺好，依流程測血糖、給糖，再找原因。
plain.en: Blood sugar too low: sweating, shaking, blankness, sudden quietness. Sit or lie them safely, check and give sugar per protocol, then find the cause.

plain.zh: 長時間壓迫讓皮膚缺血受傷；瘦、吃不下、躺著不動的老人家，腳跟和尾椎兩天就會紅。
plain.en: Skin damaged by prolonged pressure cutting off blood flow; in a thin, poorly fed, bed-bound older person the heels and tailbone redden within two days.

plain.zh: 從住院第一天就開始想回家：誰照顧、吃什麼質地、藥怎麼改、要不要申請長照、什麼時候回診。
plain.en: Planning the way home from day one: who cares, which food texture, how the medicines change, whether to apply for long-term care, when to follow up.

plain.zh: 政府的長期照顧服務：居家服務、喘息、日照、輔具。一通電話就能啟動評估。
plain.en: The public long-term care services: home help, respite, day care, assistive devices. One phone call starts the assessment.

plain.zh: 趁還能說的時候，和家人、團隊談：如果以後吃不下、說不出，希望怎麼被照顧。是對話，不是簽字。
plain.en: Talking with family and the team while one still can: how one wishes to be cared for if eating or speaking becomes impossible. A conversation, not a signature.

text.zh: 床號、吞嚥篩檢結果、食物質地、血糖注意、誰被通知。寫上名字的待辦才會有人做。
text.en: Bed, swallow screen result, food texture, sugar warning, who was told. A to-do with a name on it gets done.

text.zh: 床放最低、剎車、呼叫鈴在手邊、夜燈。床欄全拉起來不是防跌，是製造更高的跌。
text.en: Bed at its lowest, brakes on, call bell within reach, night light. Rails all the way up do not prevent falls; they make them higher.

text.zh: 把水變成好吞的稠度。小湯匙一口一口，坐直、下巴微收、吃完再坐半小時。
text.en: Turns water into a swallow-friendly consistency. A teaspoon at a time, upright, chin slightly tucked, and stay sitting for half an hour after.

text.zh: 胸片上右下肺的白影，告訴你食物走過哪條路。
text.en: The white shadow in the right lower lobe on the chest film tells you which road the food took.

text.zh: 吃不下的糖尿病人，每餐前測。數字低先給糖，再找藥袋裡的原因。
text.en: For a diabetic who is not eating, check before every meal. A low number gets sugar first, then a look in the medicine bag for the cause.

text.zh: 裡面是粥，煮到語言治療師說的那個稠度。她試了三次。第四次他吃了半碗。
text.en: Congee inside, cooked to the consistency the speech therapist described. She tried three times. On the fourth he ate half a bowl.

name.zh: 周全性老年評估的五個面向

text.zh: 醫療（肺炎、糖尿病、藥）、功能（日常生活功能，住院前後各問一次）、認知與心情（失智程度、譫妄、憂鬱）、營養與吞嚥（體重、質地、篩檢）、社會與環境（照顧者、長照、家裡的樓梯與地毯）。五格都填了，計畫才叫計畫；只填第一格，叫做治療肺炎。
text.en: Medical (pneumonia, diabetes, medicines), functional (activities of daily living, asked before and after the admission), cognition and mood (degree of dementia, delirium, depression), nutrition and swallowing (weight, texture, screen), social and environmental (carer, long-term care, the stairs and rugs at home). With all five boxes filled it is a plan; with only the first filled it is treating pneumonia.

name.zh: 鼻胃管為什麼不是第一個答案
name.en: Why a feeding tube is not the first answer

text.zh: 鼻胃管不能防止吸入性肺炎：口水還是會嗆，胃內容物還會逆流。失智的長者常常拔管，接著就是約束，然後是譫妄與壓力性損傷。先做的事：吞嚥篩檢、調整食物質地、坐直餵、少量多餐、口腔清潔、找出吃不下的原因（藥、便秘、憂鬱、假牙）。真的要談管子，就在會談室和家人談，談的是他希望的生活，不是一條管子。
text.en: A nasogastric tube does not prevent aspiration pneumonia: saliva still goes down the wrong way and stomach contents still reflux. Older people with dementia often pull it out; restraints follow, then delirium and pressure injuries. First do the other things: swallow screen, adjusted food texture, upright feeding, small frequent meals, mouth care, and the reasons for not eating (medicines, constipation, depression, dentures). If a tube must be discussed, discuss it in the family room, about the life he wants, not about a tube.

text.zh: 住院的老人家掉功能，常常不是因為病，是因為床：躺著不動、尿管、禁食、整夜的警報與抽血、沒戴眼鏡助聽器。幾天就能讓一個自己走路的人變成需要人扶。對策很簡單也很難：白天坐椅子吃飯、每天走到走廊、能拔的管子早點拔、晚上關燈讓他睡、出院準備從第一天開始。
text.en: Older people lose function in hospital less from the disease than from the bed: lying still, a catheter, nil by mouth, alarms and blood tests all night, glasses and hearing aids left in a drawer. A few days can turn someone who walks alone into someone who needs an arm. The remedies are simple and hard: meals in a chair by day, a walk to the corridor every day, tubes out as early as possible, lights off at night so he sleeps, and discharge planning from day one.

note.zh: 晨會：檢驗穩定，先問功能
note.en: Round: tests stable; ask about function first

lines.zh: 內科病房早上七點四十五分。許主治口袋裡的小手電筒露出一截，茶葉蛋在旁邊。
lines.en: The medical ward, quarter to eight. A small torch peeks from Dr Hsu's pocket, the tea egg beside it.

lines.zh: 5 床水木伯，八十八歲，吸入性肺炎第二天，抗生素依醫囑，燒退了。問題是：幾乎沒吃。太太說他在家本來吃很好。
lines.en: Bed 5, Uncle Shui-Mu, eighty-eight, day two of aspiration pneumonia, antibiotics per order, fever settled. The problem: he is barely eating. His wife says he ate well at home.

lines.zh: 檢驗都穩定。那今天要評估的是什麼？
lines.en: The tests are all stable. So what are we assessing today?

lines.zh: 功能。周全性老年評估：吞嚥、皮膚、藥、照顧者。
lines.en: Function. A comprehensive geriatric assessment: swallowing, skin, medicines, the carer.

lines.zh: 五個面向，一個都不要跳。先去看人。
lines.en: Five domains; skip none. Go and see the person first.

note.zh: 功能、皮膚，和一支保溫瓶

lines.zh: 醫生，他都不吃。是不是我煮得不好？
lines.en: Doctor, he won't eat. Is it my cooking?

lines.zh: 粥很好。我就是……吞下去會咳。
lines.en: The congee is fine. It's just… when I swallow, I cough.

lines.zh: 水木嫂，不是您的粥。是他的喉嚨變慢了。我們一步一步看。
lines.en: Mrs Shui-Mu, it is not your congee. His throat has slowed down. We will look step by step.

guide.zh: 和水木嫂談住院前的功能
guide.en: Ask Mrs Shui-Mu about function before admission

lines.zh: 檢驗穩定但生活退步。先問：一個月前他自己做得到哪些事？現在呢？
lines.en: Stable tests but declining daily life. First: a month ago, what could he do by himself? And now?

post.zh: 一個月前他自己洗澡、自己走去巷口買報紙。這兩週我要扶。
post.en: A month ago he bathed himself and walked to the corner for the paper. These two weeks I have to hold him.

post.zh: 日常生活功能從「自己」變成「要扶」，這才是主訴。肺炎只是把它照亮了。
post.en: Activities of daily living went from “himself” to “needs holding”. That is the real complaint; the pneumonia only lit it up.

lines.zh: 瘦、吃不下、躺兩天。壓力性損傷的好發部位，一處一處看。
lines.en: Thin, not eating, two days in bed. Pressure injury sites, one by one.

post.zh: 左腳跟有一塊紅，壓下去會變白。記部位、時間、大小，兩小時翻身，腳跟懸空。
post.en: A red patch on the left heel that blanches. Record site, time and size; turn two-hourly, heels floated.
On the board, with my name on it.

note.zh: 一小匙水；鼻胃管的問題
note.en: A teaspoon of water; the feeding-tube question

guide.zh: 和吳語言治療師做吞嚥篩檢
guide.en: Run the swallow screen with Wu

lines.zh: 餵之前先篩。順序你來排，湯匙我來拿。
lines.en: Screen before you feed. You set the order; I hold the spoon.

q.en: The order of a bedside swallow screen

steps.zh: 清醒、能坐直、能自己咳嗽
steps.en: Awake, able to sit upright, able to cough

steps.zh: 一小匙水，看嗆咳與聲音變濕
steps.en: A teaspoon of water; watch for cough and wet voice
If clear, try a sip from a cup

steps.zh: 記錄結果，決定食物質地
steps.en: Record the result; decide the food texture

post.zh: 小匙過了，杯喝有一點嗆咳。今天：軟質、水要增稠、坐直、小口。粥可以，稠一點。
post.en: Teaspoon clear, a slight choking cough on the cup. Today: soft texture, thickened fluids, upright, small mouthfuls. Congee is fine, thicker.

guide.zh: 回答水木嫂的鼻胃管問題

lines.zh: 隔壁床放了鼻胃管，灌進去就不會嗆了吧？要不要也放一條？
lines.en: The man in the next bed has a nasogastric tube. Nothing goes down the wrong way then, does it? Should he have one too?

q.zh: 家屬問要不要放鼻胃管。你怎麼說？
q.en: The family asks about a feeding tube. What do you say?

options.zh: 先調質地、坐直小口、少量多餐，找吃不下的原因
options.en: Texture, upright small mouthfuls, small frequent meals, find the cause first

why.zh: 鼻胃管不能防止吸入性肺炎，失智長者常拔掉。先做能做的，管子的事到會談室好好談。
why.en: A nasogastric tube does not prevent aspiration pneumonia and people with dementia often pull it out. Do what can be done first; the tube deserves a proper conversation in the family room.

options.zh: 放鼻胃管比較安全，今天就放
options.en: A tube is safer; place it today

why.zh: 「安全」是個錯覺：口水照樣嗆，管子常被拔，接著是約束。
why.en: “Safer” is an illusion: saliva still aspirates, the tube gets pulled, and restraints follow.

options.en: Old people eat less; leave it

why.zh: 吃不下有原因：藥、便秘、憂鬱、假牙、吞嚥。每一個都找得到。
why.en: Not eating has causes: medicines, constipation, depression, dentures, swallowing. Every one can be found.

post.zh: 下午會談室，女兒也會視訊進來。談的是他想要的生活，不是管子。
post.en: Family room this afternoon; the daughter joins by video. The topic is the life he wants, not a tube.

guide.en: Read the message at the station

sub.zh: 媽媽一個人顧得來嗎？要不要送安養？
sub.en: Can Mum cope alone? Should we look at a care home?

lines.zh: 我在台中。媽媽八十六歲了，一個人顧得來嗎？是不是該送安養？我下午可以視訊。
lines.en: I'm in Taichung. Mum is eighty-six; can she cope alone? Should we look at a care home? I can video-call this afternoon.

lines.zh: 下午三點半會談室，我們一起談：功能、吞嚥、長照可以幫什麼。先不急著決定。
lines.en: Half past three in the family room; we'll talk together about function, swallowing and what long-term care can offer. No decision needed yet.

lines.zh: 出院準備從今天開始，不是出院那天。
lines.en: Discharge planning starts today, not on the day he leaves.

note.zh: 右下肺；一顆要小心的藥
note.en: Right lower lobe; one tablet to watch

guide.en: The chest film at the workstation

lines.zh: 肺炎在哪一邊、哪一葉？為什麼是那裡？
lines.en: Which side, which lobe? And why there?

question.zh: 吸入性肺炎為什麼最常在右下肺？
question.en: Why does aspiration pneumonia favour the right lower lobe?

answer.zh: 右主支氣管比左邊粗、直、角度小，吸入的東西順著重力最容易掉進右下葉；躺著吸入時則常到上葉的後段。所以餵食要坐直、吃完再坐一段時間。
answer.en: The right main bronchus is wider, straighter and more vertical than the left, so aspirated material follows gravity into the right lower lobe; aspiration while lying down tends to reach the posterior upper segments instead. Hence feed upright and keep them sitting for a while after.

post.zh: 影像解釋了過去，吞嚥篩檢保護未來。
post.en: The image explains the past; the swallow screen protects the future.

guide.en: Meet Yu the pharmacist at the cart

sub.zh: 5 床的降血糖藥是磺醯脲類，吃不下要小心
sub.en: Bed 5's diabetes tablet is a sulfonylurea; careful while he is not eating

lines.zh: 他的降血糖藥是磺醯脲類。在家吃得好沒事，現在一天吃兩口粥，藥還照吃，血糖會掉。
lines.en: His diabetes tablet is a sulfonylurea. Fine when he ate well at home; now he has two mouthfuls of congee a day and the tablet carries on, the sugar will fall.

lines.zh: 吃不下的時候，藥也要跟著變。我請許主治依醫囑調整，每餐前測血糖。
lines.en: When the eating changes, the medicines must change too. I'll ask Dr Hsu to adjust per order, with a sugar check before every meal.

lines.zh: 寫上板。寫上誰去改。
lines.en: On the board. With the name of whoever changes it.

note.zh: 突然安靜的水木伯；低血糖
note.en: A suddenly quiet Uncle Shui-Mu; hypoglycaemia

lines.zh: 醫生，他突然不講話了，一直冒汗。
lines.en: Doctor, he's suddenly stopped talking and he's sweating.

lines.zh: 水木伯眼神發直，額頭濕濕的，叫他只會慢慢轉頭。
lines.en: Uncle Shui-Mu stares, forehead damp; when called he only turns his head slowly.

options.zh: 側躺安全，依流程測血糖，能吞就給糖，叫護理師
options.en: Safe on his side, check sugar per protocol, sugar if he can swallow, call the nurse

why.zh: 糖尿病、吃不下、磺醯脲類、冒汗發呆：先想低血糖。不能安全吞就不要餵，依醫囑用別的路。
why.en: Diabetes, poor intake, a sulfonylurea, sweating and blankness: low sugar first. If he cannot swallow safely, do not feed; use another route per order.

options.zh: 先做意識評估，可能是中風
options.en: Formal neuro assessment first; could be a stroke

why.zh: 中風要想，但血糖一分鐘就能排除，先測。
why.en: Think stroke too, but a sugar takes a minute to exclude; check it first.

options.en: Give him a mouthful of congee

why.zh: 意識不清的人餵粥，就是下一次吸入性肺炎。
why.en: Feeding congee to someone drowsy is the next aspiration pneumonia.

post.zh: 血糖低。糖給了，他回來了，第一句話問粥。
post.en: Sugar low. Sugar given; he's back, and his first words were about congee.

post.zh: 藥師中午才提醒過。板上寫了誰去改？
post.en: The pharmacist warned us at noon. Whose name was on the board to change it?

post.zh: 我的。還沒改。現在改，依醫囑。
post.en: Mine. Not done yet. Doing it now, per order.

lines.zh: 寫上去：低血糖一次、藥已調、每餐前測、進食差要通知。然後簽名。
lines.en: Write it: one hypoglycaemia, tablet adjusted, sugar before every meal, report poor intake. Then sign.

q.zh: 找到交班板，把血糖事件與計畫寫上去
q.en: Find the handover board and write the sugar event and plan

post.en: That line has a name on it now.

note.zh: 上個月的跌倒；回家的計畫
note.en: Last month's fall; the plan for home

guide.en: Family meeting in the family room

lines.zh: 有一件事我沒說。上個月他半夜上廁所跌倒，沒受傷，他叫我不要講。
lines.en: There is something I didn't say. Last month he fell going to the toilet at night. Not hurt; he told me not to mention it.

lines.zh: 夜間跌倒，不要只歸因地毯。我們把那一晚拆開來看。
lines.en: A night-time fall: not just the rug. Let us take that night apart.

post.zh: 夜尿、暗、拖鞋、藥、肌肉。五個原因，每一個都能改一點。長照的居家服務和輔具今天就申請。
post.en: Night-time urination, darkness, slippers, medicines, muscle. Five causes, each can be nudged. Apply for long-term care home help and aids today.

lines.zh: 你早上說稠一點、坐直、小口。我回家煮了第四次，他剛剛吃了半碗。
lines.en: You said thicker, upright, small mouthfuls. I went home and cooked it a fourth time; he just ate half a bowl.

lines.zh: 半碗粥，比一條管子多很多。
lines.en: Half a bowl of congee is a great deal more than a tube.

lines.zh: 早上聽到要放管子，我一整天都在想是不是我餵不好。粥也沒煮。
lines.en: After hearing about a tube this morning, I spent the whole day thinking I feed him badly. I didn't even cook the congee.

lines.zh: 水木嫂，管子不是因為您。我們先把質地、姿勢、小口做好，粥還是要煮。
lines.en: Mrs Shui-Mu, a tube would not be because of you. We get texture, posture and small mouthfuls right first; the congee still needs cooking.

guide.zh: 開始談預立醫療照護諮商
guide.en: Open the advance care planning conversation

lines.zh: 我自己講。我做了一輩子木工，手還會動就好。以後吃不下了，不要用管子綁我。
lines.en: I'll say it myself. I was a carpenter all my life; as long as my hands move, I'm fine. If one day I can't eat, don't tie me to a tube.

lines.zh: 這就是預立醫療照護諮商的開始：趁他還能說。我們把它記下來，之後有專門的時間再談清楚。
lines.en: That is how advance care planning begins: while he can still say it. We write it down, and set a proper time to talk it through later.

lines.zh: （視訊）爸，我聽到了。我下週回來。
lines.en: (on video) Dad, I heard you. I'm coming home next week.

note.zh: 交班：質地、血糖、跌倒預防、誰被通知
note.en: Handover: texture, sugar, fall prevention, who was told

lines.zh: 5 床：軟質增稠、坐直小口；低血糖一次、藥已依醫囑調整、每餐前測；腳跟紅、兩小時翻身；夜間跌倒風險高，長照已轉介。
lines.en: Bed 5: soft texture and thickened fluids, upright and small mouthfuls; one hypoglycaemia, tablet adjusted per order, sugar before meals; heel redness, two-hourly turns; high night-time fall risk, long-term care referred.

lines.zh: 每一行都有名字。這份交班我收。
lines.en: Every line has a name. I'll take that handover.

lines.zh: 今天三件事：檢驗穩定先問功能；餵之前先篩；吃得少，藥要跟著變。
lines.en: Three things today: when the tests are stable, ask about function; screen before you feed; when the eating drops, the medicines follow.

lines.zh: 還有一件：床是老人家的敵人。明天讓他坐椅子吃早餐。
lines.en: And one more: the bed is the enemy. Tomorrow he eats breakfast in a chair.

lines.zh: 醫生，這個給你。剩的粥，稠的。
lines.en: Doctor, this is for you. The leftover congee. The thick kind.

lines.zh: 一支舊保溫瓶，瓶身貼著一張寫「稠」的膠帶。許主治把茶葉蛋放在旁邊，沒有剝。
lines.en: An old thermos with a strip of tape on it reading “thick”. Dr Hsu sets the tea egg beside it, unpeeled.

note.zh: 夜裡上廁所：床低、燈亮、人陪，不綁
note.en: Toilet at night: bed low, light on, someone with him, no restraints

sub.zh: 5 床一直要下床上廁所，要不要約束或包尿布？
sub.en: Bed 5 keeps trying to get up to the toilet: restraints or a nappy?

lines.zh: 5 床晚上一直要下床上廁所，夜班問要不要約束，或是包尿布就好。
lines.en: Bed 5 keeps trying to get up for the toilet. Nights are asking about restraints, or whether a nappy would do.

lines.zh: 都不要。他上個月就是半夜上廁所跌的。床放最低、夜燈開、呼叫鈴在手邊、定時陪他去，防滑鞋。約束讓跌倒變嚴重，不會變少。
lines.en: Neither. He fell going to the toilet at night last month. Bed at its lowest, night light on, call bell in reach, take him at set times, non-slip shoes. Restraints make falls worse, not fewer.

lines.zh: 還有，睡前測一次血糖。吃得少的晚上最容易低。
lines.en: And one sugar check before sleep. Nights after a poor day's eating are when it drops.

lines.zh: 複誦：不約束、床最低、夜燈、定時陪廁、防滑鞋、睡前血糖。
lines.en: Read-back: no restraints, bed lowest, night light, scheduled toileting with company, non-slip shoes, sugar before sleep.

lines.zh: 你放下電話。桌上的保溫瓶還是溫的，膠帶上那個「稠」字，有人用鉛筆描過一遍。
lines.en: You put the phone down. The thermos on the desk is still warm; someone has gone over the word “thick” on the tape in pencil.

sub.zh: 餵之前先篩；床是老人家的敵人
sub.en: Screen before you feed; the bed is the enemy
